first.rationale: Activation messaging directly addresses the larger current decline and previously improved first meaningful actions. Verify its downstream evidence and compare it with onboarding simplification, whose benefit came with higher churn in complex-workspace accounts. Promotional pricing is not preferred because its known retention damage conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run an in-product activation-messaging experiment. The verified source showed activation +6%, week-one engagement +11%, and 30-day retention +1%, directly matching the current activation decline while supporting sustainable value. Shortened onboarding could improve completion, but its verified churn risk for complex workspaces makes it less suitable for this single slot without additional segmentation safeguards. Historical results may not fully replicate, so retain an experimental holdout and measure activation, qualified usage, and retention.
